DEFECT_3_phone_swap_source.status_2026_08_22: CONFIRMED UNCHANGED, and NOT exposed in any of this run's 15 renders
DEFECT_3_phone_swap_source.runtime_evidence: The wc_swap cookie reads '4109141456+..+4107610932+..+230773' on ALL FIVE paid pages, identical to the 2026-08-22 01:30 reading. The middle value is the number WhatConverts is configured to FIND; the first is what it SWAPS IN.
DEFECT_3_phone_swap_source.new_this_run: Across all 15 renders the barred number 4107610932 appeared in ZERO tel: hrefs and ZERO page bodies. Combined with the earlier 1-in-3 observation, this is consistent with an intermittent client-side race between page render and the WhatConverts swap - not a constant defect, and not resolved either.
DEFECT_3_phone_swap_source.DECISION: UNRESOLVED AND PRESERVED. No WhatConverts change was made or proposed for execution.
DEFECT_3_phone_swap_source.why: WHATCONVERTS_API_TOKEN exists as a variable name but its value is empty, so no authenticated WhatConverts session is available and credentials must not be requested. Without authenticated evidence, 4107610932 must be treated as the DELIBERATELY CONFIGURED swap source, not as stale.
DEFECT_3_phone_swap_source.what_green_marketing_must_confirm_before: Whether 4107610932 is stale or deliberately retained in WhatConverts profile 105803.
DEFECT_3_phone_swap_source.recommended_fix_once_confirmed_stale: Change the swap SOURCE in profile 105803 from 4107610932 to the approved paid base 4107056354, and make the page markup carry 4107056354 as its hardcoded base, so a pre-swap read exposes the approved paid number.
DEFECT_3_phone_swap_source.DO_NOT: Do not remove WhatConverts. Do not change the DNI replacement number 4109141456 - it is intentional and approved. Do not treat this as a Google Ads issue and do not alter ClickCease because of it.

DEFECT_4_malformed_tel_links.status_2026_08_22: STILL LIVE on all five pages
DEFECT_4_malformed_tel_links.problem: Two of the three are not E.164. 'tel:(410) 705-6354' contains parentheses and a space; 'tel:4107056354' omits the country code. Only the DNI link is well formed. Mobile dialers handle malformed tel: values inconsistently.
DEFECT_4_malformed_tel_links.required: Every hardcoded tel: href must match ^tel:\+1[0-9]{10}$, i.e. tel:+14107056354.
DEFECT_4_malformed_tel_links.caution: Normalize the href ONLY. Do not change visible text, element attributes or classes that WhatConverts keys on to find and swap numbers, or DNI will break.
DEFECT_4_malformed_tel_links.acceptance: All hardcoded tel: hrefs are E.164 AND the swap still produces (410) 914-1456.

DEFECT_5_duplicate_form_instances.status_2026_08_22: STILL LIVE on all five pages
DEFECT_5_duplicate_form_instances.observed: Three <form> elements per page, 34 duplicate DOM ids per page, three submit buttons per page.
DEFECT_5_duplicate_form_instances.why_it_matters: Duplicate ids are invalid HTML. label[for] resolves to the first match only, so labels on the second and third instances are not programmatically associated - an accessibility failure. A GTM form-submit trigger keyed on an id or a generic form selector can bind to the wrong instance or fire more than once, which is a plausible contributor to duplicate form conversions.
DEFECT_5_duplicate_form_instances.required: Prefer ONE rendered form per page. If the layout genuinely needs three, every DOM id, label for-attribute, error container id, field id and event binding must be unique per instance.
DEFECT_5_duplicate_form_instances.acceptance: document.querySelectorAll('form').length === 1, OR zero duplicate ids, and exactly one conversion per successful submission.

DEFECT_6_no_privacy_or_terms_links.status_2026_08_22: STILL LIVE - zero privacy or terms links on any of the five pages, desktop and mobile
DEFECT_6_no_privacy_or_terms_links.quality_signal_context: HVAC Repair and HVAC Replacement keywords report landing-page experience BELOW_AVERAGE; AC Repair reports AVERAGE. Missing legal links are a recognised trust signal and a PLAUSIBLE contributor. Google does not expose per-signal attribution, so this remains an INFERENCE, not proven causation.
DEFECT_6_no_privacy_or_terms_links.required: Add Privacy Policy and Terms links using REAL existing Ambient URLs only. Do not invent legal text and do not invent URLs. If no published policy exists, that is a client decision, not a developer decision.

CORRECTION_to_addendum_B_detection_metho.what_happened: This run's first pass tested for a <script src> containing 'whatconverts' and reported WhatConverts ABSENT on all five pages.
CORRECTION_to_addendum_B_detection_metho.correction: That was a harness error, not a site regression. WhatConverts is injected through GTM-PQTPQ436, so it has no matching script src. Its presence is proven at runtime by the four wc_ cookies - wc_client, wc_client_current, wc_swap and wc_visitor - which are set on all five pages in every render.
CORRECTION_to_addendum_B_detection_metho.standing_rule: Assert WhatConverts presence from the wc_ runtime cookies, never from a script src pattern.
